whenToUse: Project plans where a tree of phases and tasks owns bars dragged and resized along a time axis
Roadmaps, status reports and team capacity views read anywhere from a single day to a whole year
Delivery tracked against a frozen plan, or work chained by dependency arrows and milestone diamonds

whenNotToUse.when: A finished planner page with an edit dialog, dispatch rows and rules checked on drop
A quarter of sales deals grouped by account, beside board, table and calendar views
A list of dated steps or updates read in order, with no bars to drag or resize

agentNotes: Replace `buildBars`, which dates its sample bars from the start of the current week, with your own records
Every example seeds bars through `defaultEvents` alone; pass `events` with `onEventsChange` to keep edits in your store
